diagnosis.interpretation: The balanced one-step update acquired the two leaked boundary behaviors only while their complementary supports remained present. It did not transfer either behavior into the fully unhelped E1 interaction: children treated inline evidence labels as filesystem paths, and coordinators generated malformed tool syntax instead of passive prose. This is an interaction-policy failure, not excessive use of IPython for mathematics.

current_authorization.reason: Fresh E1 produced zero qualifying trajectories, below the unchanged minimum of four. A new, thinner transition rung must independently admit at least four complete distinct trajectories before another optimizer update.

safest_next_action: Keep R4 frozen. Introduce and evaluate one intermediate support-removal rung per boundary: first weaken E0c child evidence hints while retaining exact coordinator yield, and separately weaken E0d yield guidance while retaining constrained child reporting.
